description: An agile sprint board on the Svelte 5 data grid: status lanes from board.groupBy crossed with a swimlane per assignee through board.swimlaneBy, an enforced WIP limit on In progress with enforceWip, and a story-point roll-up in every lane header from board.laneSummary. Drag a card across a swimlane band to reassign its owner as well as its status, double-click to edit, and collapse lanes you are not working in. The board renderer ships in @svgrid/enterprise.
keywords: svelte board story points per lane

faq.question: How do swimlanes work?
faq.answer: swimlaneBy names a second field, assignee here, and the board draws a horizontal band per value across every lane. Dropping a card in another band writes that field too, so one drag can change status and owner.

faq.question: How is the WIP limit enforced?
faq.answer: The lane definition carries wipLimit and enforceWip rejects a drop or keyboard move that would exceed it; the lane header shows the count against the limit and turns red when full.

faq.question: How are story points summed per lane?
faq.answer: laneSummary receives the lane's rows and returns a string; the demo sums points and the board prints it in the header, recomputed after every move.
